title: Restore Matrix From Row and Column Sums

solutions.optimal:
class Solution:
    def restoreMatrix(self, rowSum: list[int], colSum: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        rows = rowSum[:]
        cols = colSum[:]
        m, n = len(rows), len(cols)
        ans = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        i = j = 0
        while i < m and j < n:
            x = min(rows[i], cols[j])
            ans[i][j] = x
            rows[i] -= x
            cols[j] -= x
            if rows[i] == 0:
                i += 1
            if j < n and cols[j] == 0:
                j += 1
        return ans
